scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run db:migrate --prefix server
scripts.seed: npm run seed --prefix server && npm run experiment --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
